development_training_contract.early_stopping_objective: mean masked proper probabilistic loss across one-hour tuning capture runs with equal run weights

development_training_contract.checkpoint_storage: best peer states retained in volatile memory only
development_training_contract.serialization: sorted CPU tensors in deterministic metadata-free safetensors bytes
development_training_contract.publication_order: reload-verify model state and predictions before atomically publishing model then canonical policy
development_training_contract.fully_censored_minibatch_policy: skip before device transfer and record minibatch and row counts
development_training_contract.probability_calibration_selection_object: mean binary cross entropy across six calibration capture runs with equal run weights

action_policy_contract.risk_adjusted_strength: median after-cost payoff minus profile-specific lower-tail and predicted maximum-adverse-excursion penalties
action_policy_contract.quality_score: risk-adjusted strength times calibrated positive-payoff, non-adverse-selection, and predictable-regime probabilities divided by predicted q90 maximum adverse excursion
candidate_gates: profile-specific q90 maximum-adverse-excursion to median-payoff ratio
tie_break_order: lower predicted q90 maximum adverse excursion
long before short only as the final deterministic tie
action_policy_contract.threshold_quantile_estimator: median of each active capture run's within-run linear quantile
action_policy_contract.threshold_selection_data: six whole chronological policy-selection tuning runs only
action_policy_contract.selection_objective: mean cumulative capture-run net bps minus profile-weighted worst realized drawdown and mean cumulative capture-run maximum-adverse-excursion penalties
action_policy_contract.drawdown_order: cohort run then actual exit monotonic time then signal-order tie break
action_policy_contract.nonoverlap_semantics: at most one open research trade per capture run and symbol

prospective_evaluation_contract.quiet_qualification_run_status: design-consumed feature diagnostic; permanently ineligible as sealed financial confirmation
prospective_evaluation_contract.sealed_positive_after_cost_gate: Bonferroni familywise lower bound across one ML baseline and two AI overlays must be positive
required_model_metrics: pinball loss by horizon, side, symbol, and activity regime
Brier score and calibration for probability heads
directional balanced accuracy and Matthews correlation coefficient
after-cost net return, annualized return, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, maximum drawdown, expected shortfall, profit factor, and turnover
performance sensitivity to fees, latency, spread, depth, slippage, and missed fills
promotion_requires: positive after-cost lower confidence bound on the sealed aggregate
no symbol or activity regime with an unacceptable loss concentration
drawdown and expected-shortfall gates for the selected risk profile
the simplest candidate when evidence is statistically indistinguishable

ai_comparison_contract.present_but_failed_review_policy: retain paired observation with zero AI exposure

ai_comparison_contract.ai_queue_model: one FIFO single-server queue per alternative candidate model in historical decision order
ai_comparison_contract.causal_recent_direction_definition: per-feature mean of the final 16 scaled events minus the preceding 16 scaled events
